mutant.description: Relationship-grain collapse on Cottonwood holdings: cot fact_holdings is Relationship x Account x Asset, so a naive sum double-counts any (account, asset) pair held under more than one relationship. Mutant: skip the collapse and sum naively.
mutant.expected: The naive sum should exceed the deduped sum, and only the deduped sum should tie to the producer's own published total.
mutant.observed: FIRED: naive $482,772,843.42 vs deduped $482,567,772.65 -- $205,070.77 phantom from 2 of 17,138 pairs appearing under two Relationship IDs. The DEDUPED figure ties EXACTLY to platinum partner_custody_total @2026-08-10 (difference < $0.01); the naive figure ties to nothing. Small in magnitude at this date, but the tie is what establishes the collapse is correct rather than merely plausible, and the inflation factor is date-dependent.

surprises: The 'Opal Satellite N' family is 100% Opal by constituent -- a Satellite 50 is 75/25 Opal Intermediate-Term / Opal Short-Term, so the satellite sleeve is itself an Opal model. Meanwhile 'Opal - Income', whose name sounds purest, holds only third-party ETFs and scores 0% on a constituent test. The names that sound mixed are pure and the one that sounds pure is not.

89% of the reported non-Opal balance ($6,225,293.18 of $7,005,515.33) is a definitional artifact rather than non-Opal money -- it comes entirely from two LEAF strategies scoring 0% purely because they have no constituents. The only genuinely non-Opal constituents in all 18 are three Sleeves worth $780,222.16.

The two Anna accounts hold $9,121,075.85 (19.6%) of our OWN ETFs directly (DIVZ, IDVZ, PFDE, PFOE) and $37,415,272.86 (80.4%) third-party, and both are flagged isManaged=False in the rebalancer despite sitting on Andrew's strategy list. So what is unmeasurable about them is the model ATTRIBUTION, not the content.
The T1 reconciliation closed to the cent on the first attempt, and the residual was exactly a quantity measured for a different purpose in T1 (the off-list Opal-named strategies).

The vendor lift was authorized, warranted and still did not work, failing in a discriminating way -- /auth/token succeeded while /api/models/{id} 401'd. Recorded as an observation with three candidate mechanisms named as untested, not as a diagnosis.
